## Why

Explain the observable outcome. Link the issue with Closes or Refs.

## What

Summarize scope, affected profiles and compatibility.

## How to test

Record exact commands, revision and real results, including exposed neighboring behavior.

## Evidence

- Independent review: TO FILL

Record findings/dispositions and the actual environments exercised. For a fix, attach the same final test failing before and passing after it. Explain any unexercised surface and its next owner/action.

## Rollback

## Ownership and next action

Record the implementing session, handoff if applicable, remaining step and retained resources with owner/recheck trigger.
